cause: Each newly earned character unconditionally assigned both full-screen Canvas dimensions. Even unchanged dimensions clear live pixels and reset the backing store, interrupting particle continuity during rapid typing.
change: Keep the active backing store until dimensions actually change.
preserved: particle trajectories, timing, opacity, color, size and resolution

regression.before: Desktop fails with 30 backing-store resets during a 15-letter burst
regression.after: Desktop Chrome, touch Chrome and WebKit all pass; zero resets after allocation and existing particle pixel preserved synchronously

profile.conditions: isolated muted Chrome; 1440x1000, DPR 2, 4x CPU throttling, 33 consecutive correct characters at 30 ms intervals
profile.boundary: Single controlled before/after samples. Frame P95 did not improve; no physical-device or universal no-jank claim.

linux.runtime: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64, Node 24.18.1, locked Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium/WebKit; Chrome channel mapped to matching bundled Chromium
